roomRentLimitPerDay.quote: up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day, or the actual charges, whichever is lower

proportionateDeduction.quote: the Company shall reduce the amount payable for Associated Medical Expenses in the same proportion as the eligible rate per day bears to the actual rate per day of the room charges

icu.quote: Proportionate deductions shall not be applied in respect of ICU charges, as ICU charges do not differ by room category.

copayPercent.quote: Each admissible claim in respect of an Insured Person aged 61 years or above shall be subject to a co-payment of 20% of the admissible claim amount

nonPayables.quote: Items listed in Annexure I (items for which coverage is not available in the policy) are not payable.

notes: Co-pay of 20% applies only to insured persons aged 61 or above (Suresh, 62); Kamala (58) has none.
